1 · First half

How it started.

The Thunder led 25–19 after one quarter. At the half, the Thunder led 57–36.

2 · The difference

Shai: 30 points and 9 assists in three quarters

11 of 20 from the floor. Sat out the fourth.

3 · How it turned

Up 21 at the half, up 31 after three

Shai, McCain and Mara combined for 67 of 114.

4 · Where it was won

Won it inside and off the bench

Points in the paint 56–32; bench points 43–23. Washington made 7 of 43 threes.
